original_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'}) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10
question_en: List the top 10 CRs that modify spec 38.133 (recent changes to the spec).
reference_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'})
MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(meeting:Meeting)
WITH cr, max(meeting.sourceReportedEndDate) AS meetingPeriodEndDate
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, meetingPeriodEndDate
ORDER BY meetingPeriodEndDate DESC, tdocNumber ASC
